game.title: Call of Duty: Black Ops
game.blurb: First-person shooter from Treyarch (RAWG also lists Raven Software and n-Space), published by Activision Blizzard (RAWG also lists Square Enix), released 2010-11-09. RAWG average playtime: 9 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter. Chapters follow the campaign places named in the Steam achievements, plus Veteran runs and Zombies.

chapters.title: Cuba and Vorkuta
chapters.summary: Castro, getting the squad out of Cuba, the prison break and escaping Vorkuta.

chapters.title: Lancer, Khe Sanh and Hue City
chapters.summary: Orders from Lancer, sabotaging the Soviet space program, the siege of Khe Sanh and the defector in Hue City. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Kowloon, the River and Laos
chapters.summary: Escaping Kowloon, the river run, the Soviet connection in Laos, the outpost, the relay station and the POW compound. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: The Ship and Rebirth Island
chapters.summary: Escaping the past, the Rebirth labs and the NOVA 6 gas, cracking the code and the ship. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Campaign Completion, Veteran and Intel
chapters.summary: Finishing the campaign, Hardened or Veteran runs by mission group, all hidden intel and campaign-wide combat feats.

chapters.title: Zombies and Dead Ops Arcade
chapters.summary: Zombies goals that do not name a map, the Pentagon thief, Dead Ops Arcade and three hidden achievements.

chapters.title: Ascension, Call of the Dead, Shangri-La and Moon
chapters.summary: The achievements for the four named Zombies maps, including co-op ones.

StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Call_of_Duty:_Black_Ops

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 865). Steam app 42700 ("Call of Duty®: Black Ops") from the store list; its schema is named "ValveTestApp42700" (a placeholder name). 3 of 68 Steam achievements are hidden; they sit among the Zombies achievements in the Steam list and were put in the Zombies chapter as a guess. RAWG's detail says 209 achievements, far more than Steam's 68. No Steam achievement mentions competitive multiplayer, so there is no multiplayer chapter. The campaign chapters group the places the achievements name, in Steam list order; which mission each place belongs to was not checked, and the slingshot, Dragon's Breath, Grim Reaper and "3 VC" feats were placed by their position in the list. The Veteran achievements name mission groups ("Operation 40," "Vorkuta," and "Executive Order"; "SOG" and "The Defector"; "Numbers," "Project Nova," and "Victor Charlie"; "Crash Site," "WMD," and "Payback"; "Rebirth" and "Redemption"). StrategyWiki has the guide at completion stage 2, but only 2 of its 15 mission pages are written: Operation 40 (about 2,100 characters) and Vorkuta (about 2,700); U.S.D.D., Executive Order, S.O.G., The Defector, Project Nova, Victor Charlie, Crash Site, WMD, Payback, Rebirth, Revelations, Redemption and First Strike are linked but not written, as are Items and Weapons. Achievements and trophies (about 8,800), Plot, Gameplay, Multiplayer, Characters, Controls and Walkthrough are written. Its contents do not list "Numbers", which a Steam achievement names. So it was not used. callofduty.fandom.com answers the API under "Call of Duty: Black Ops" with 500 or more linked articles (the API limit); names only were looked at, nothing copied.
